This blog is where I'll write down what I learn and what I wish I had found earlier.

My background is in statistics, and my favourite part of it is time series. I'll write about state-space models and Kalman filters, with code in R and Python so you can run it yourself. I also plan tutorials on statistics, deep learning, AI engineering and data engineering, aimed at people who want to see how the pieces fit together in practice.

If a post has code, it will link to a repository you can clone and run.
